en.definition: A `NinoSerializer.Serialize(...)` or `NinoDeserializer.Deserialize(...)` call that takes your value and a `byte[]`, span, `ReadOnlySequence<byte>`, buffer writer or `Stream`, as opposed to a call that passes a `Writer` or `Reader` you created yourself, and to the values Nino reads and writes inside a call. Each top-level call is self-contained: it starts and ends its own [reference tracking](/en/docs/v4/reference-tracking).

zh.definition: `NinoSerializer.Serialize(...)` 或 `NinoDeserializer.Deserialize(...)` 这类调用：直接传入你的值和 `byte[]`、span、`ReadOnlySequence<byte>`、缓冲区写入器或 `Stream`。与之相对的，是传入你自己创建的 `Writer` 或 `Reader` 的调用，以及 Nino 在一次调用内部读写的值。每次顶层调用都自成一体，自己开始、自己结束[引用追踪](/zh/docs/v4/reference-tracking)。

en.definition: One message on a stream that carries several, with its length in front (commonly 4 bytes, little-endian) so the reader knows where it ends. Nino writes no frames of its own: `Deserialize<T>(stream)` reads one value up to the end of the stream, so a socket or a file of records frames each value; see [Several Messages on One Stream](/en/docs/v4/advanced/streams#frames).

zh.definition: 一个流上传多条消息时，其中的一条，前面带着它的长度（通常是 4 字节小端），读的一方据此知道它在哪里结束。Nino 自己不写帧：`Deserialize<T>(stream)` 会一直读到流结束，只读出一个值，所以 socket 或记录文件要给每个值分帧；参见[一个流上的多条消息](/zh/docs/v4/advanced/streams#frames)。

en.definition: `SerializeBoxed` and `DeserializeBoxed`, the overloads that take an `object` and a `Type`, for a type known only at run time that shares no common `[NinoType]` base with the others; see [The Boxed API](/en/docs/v4/basic#the-boxed-api).

zh.definition: `SerializeBoxed` 和 `DeserializeBoxed`，即接收 `object` 和 `Type` 的重载。类型到运行时才能确定、又与其他类型没有共同的 `[NinoType]` 基类型时，用它们；参见[装箱 API](/zh/docs/v4/basic#the-boxed-api)。

en.definition: The code that writes and reads one type: generated for each `[NinoType]`, built into Nino for the BCL types, or [written by you](/en/docs/v4/custom-formatters). The **formatter cache** is `NinoFormatterCache<T>`, the static field through which a call finds the formatter of `T`.

zh.definition: 负责读写某一种类型的代码：每个 `[NinoType]` 都有生成的格式化器，BCL 类型的格式化器内置在 Nino 中，也可以[自己编写](/zh/docs/v4/custom-formatters)。**格式化器缓存**是 `NinoFormatterCache<T>`，调用通过这个静态字段找到 `T` 的格式化器。

en.definition: On the .NET 8 SDK and later, the generator redirects each call whose type is known at compile time straight to that type's formatter, skipping the formatter cache; see [Interceptors](/en/docs/v4/performance#interceptors).

zh.definition: 使用 .NET 8 SDK 及以上版本时，只要调用的类型在编译期已知，源生成器就把这个调用直接转给该类型的格式化器，跳过格式化器缓存；参见[拦截器](/zh/docs/v4/performance#interceptors)。

en.definition: A `NinoArrayBufferWriter` that Nino keeps per thread. A call that returns a `byte[]`, or writes into a buffer writer other than `NinoArrayBufferWriter`, serializes into it first and then copies the bytes out.

zh.definition: Nino 为每个线程保留的一个 `NinoArrayBufferWriter`。返回 `byte[]` 的调用，以及写入 `NinoArrayBufferWriter` 以外的缓冲区写入器的调用，会先序列化到这里，再把字节拷贝出去。

en.definition: An unmanaged value that Nino writes as its memory, in one copy, with padding bytes zeroed: primitives, enums, `DateTime`, `Guid`, and unmanaged structs that qualify (see [Structs](/en/docs/v4/defining-types#structs)). Arrays and lists of raw values are one block copy.

zh.definition: Nino 按内存原样写入的非托管值，只需一次拷贝，填充字节清零：基元类型、枚举、`DateTime`、`Guid`，以及符合条件的非托管结构体（参见[结构体](/zh/docs/v4/defining-types#structs)）。原始值的数组和列表是一次整块拷贝。

en.definition: A struct or sealed class whose values always take the same number of bytes, returned by `NinoSerializer.GetFixedSize<T>()`; see [Fixed-Size Types](/en/docs/v4/performance#fixed-size-types).

zh.definition: 每个值都占用相同字节数的结构体或密封类，字节数由 `NinoSerializer.GetFixedSize<T>()` 返回；参见[固定大小的类型](/zh/docs/v4/performance#fixed-size-types)。

en.definition: The default format of a `[NinoType]`: members in declaration order, with no names or lengths. Smallest and fastest, but any change to the members changes the format; see [Evolving Your Data](/en/docs/v4/evolving-data#positional).

zh.definition: `[NinoType]` 的默认格式：成员按声明顺序写入，不带名称和长度。最小、最快，但成员的任何改动都会改变格式；参见[数据演进](/zh/docs/v4/evolving-data#positional)。

en.definition: The two other formats (`NinoFormat.VersionTolerant` and `NinoFormat.Keyed`). A version-tolerant object writes its length in bytes first, so members can be appended later; a keyed object writes each member with a key (a hash of its name) and a length, so members can be added, removed, reordered or renamed. See [Evolving Your Data](/en/docs/v4/evolving-data).

zh.definition: 另外两种格式（`NinoFormat.VersionTolerant` 和 `NinoFormat.Keyed`）。版本容错的对象先写入自己的字节长度，以后可以追加成员；键控的对象为每个成员写入一个键（成员名的哈希）和长度，成员可以增删、重排和改名。参见[数据演进](/zh/docs/v4/evolving-data)。

en.definition: A C# file in your project (`[assembly: NinoLayouts(...)]`, usually `NinoLayouts.cs`) that records the layout of every type whose bytes outlive a build. The analyzer compares your types with it as you type and reports a change that would break data already written or builds already shipped (NINO034 to NINO037). Created with the refactoring *Create the layout baseline* or `nino-gen layouts`, never written by hand, and never part of your assembly; see [Layout Baseline](/en/docs/v4/evolving-data#layout-baseline).

zh.definition: 项目里的一个 C# 文件（`[assembly: NinoLayouts(...)]`，通常叫 `NinoLayouts.cs`），记下所有字节会比当前构建活得更久的类型的布局。你写代码时，分析器拿你的类型和它比对，改动会读坏已写出的数据、或让已发布的版本读不了新数据时，就报出来（NINO034 到 NINO037）。用重构“创建布局基线”（*Create the layout baseline*）或 `nino-gen layouts` 生成，不用手写，也不会编进你的程序集；参见[布局基线](/zh/docs/v4/evolving-data#layout-baseline)。

en.definition: A place that holds a value: a member, a collection element, a dictionary value, or the variable you pass by `ref`. What Nino writes for a value depends on the slot's declared type.

zh.definition: 存放一个值的地方：一个成员、一个集合元素、一个字典值，或者你按 `ref` 传入的变量。Nino 为一个值写出什么，取决于槽位的声明类型。

en.definition: The bytes Nino writes before a class value: a presence byte for a sealed class, a 4-byte type id for a type that can have subtypes; a struct has none. See [How a Polymorphic Value Is Written](/en/docs/v4/polymorphism#how-a-polymorphic-value-is-written).

zh.definition: Nino 在类的值之前写入的字节：密封类是一个存在字节，可能有子类型的类型是 4 字节的类型 ID；结构体没有头部。参见[多态值的写入方式](/zh/docs/v4/polymorphism#how-a-polymorphic-value-is-written)。

en.definition: The byte Nino writes before a sealed class or a nullable value: 0 for `null`, 1 when a value follows. See [Wire Format](/en/docs/v4/wire-format#conventions).

zh.definition: Nino 在密封类或可空值之前写入的一个字节：0 表示 `null`，1 表示后面跟着值。参见[二进制格式](/zh/docs/v4/wire-format#conventions)。

en.definition: The 4-byte hash of a type's name that Nino writes before a value whose declared type can have subtypes, so the reader knows which type to create; it can only be a registered subtype of the declared type. See [Polymorphism](/en/docs/v4/polymorphism#how-a-polymorphic-value-is-written).

zh.definition: 类型名的 4 字节哈希。声明类型可能有子类型时，Nino 在值之前写入它，读取方据此知道要创建哪个类型；它只能是声明类型的已注册子类型。参见[多态](/zh/docs/v4/polymorphism#how-a-polymorphic-value-is-written)。

en.definition: `Deserialize(data, ref value)`, which fills the value you pass, and the objects, lists and dictionaries it holds, in place instead of creating new ones; see [Into an Existing Value](/en/docs/v4/basic#into-an-existing-value).

zh.definition: `Deserialize(data, ref value)`：直接填充你传入的值，以及它持有的对象、列表和字典，不新建；参见[反序列化到已有值](/zh/docs/v4/basic#into-an-existing-value)。

en.definition: A `[NinoType]` class marked `[NinoPooled]`: Nino takes new instances of it from a built-in pool and returns dropped ones to it; see [`[NinoPooled]`](/en/docs/v4/pooling#ninopooled).

zh.definition: 标记了 `[NinoPooled]` 的 `[NinoType]` 类：Nino 需要新实例时从内置对象池里取，丢弃的实例还回池里；参见 [`[NinoPooled]`](/zh/docs/v4/pooling#ninopooled)。

en.definition: What receives an instance that [reuse deserialization](/en/docs/v4/pooling) drops from a slot: a handler registered with `NinoSettings.SetRecycler<T>`, otherwise the instance's own pool (`ReturnToPool()`), otherwise nobody. See [Where Dropped Instances Go](/en/docs/v4/pooling#where-dropped-instances-go).

zh.definition: [复用反序列化](/zh/docs/v4/pooling)从槽位中丢弃实例时，由它接手：先交给用 `NinoSettings.SetRecycler<T>` 注册的处理函数；没有就交给实例自己的对象池（`ReturnToPool()`）；再没有就不处理。参见[被丢弃的实例去哪里](/zh/docs/v4/pooling#where-dropped-instances-go)。

en.definition: The code the generator emits into each assembly to list its `[NinoType]`s, their formatters and their type ids. Nino loads it the first time it meets a type of that assembly, or a type id it does not know, so no initialization call is needed; `NinoRegistry.EnsureInitialized(assembly)` loads it ahead of time. The **global registry** is the table of every `[NinoType]` through which values declared as `object` are dispatched; see [Dispatch](/en/docs/v4/polymorphism#dispatch).

zh.definition: 生成器在每个程序集中生成的代码，列出这个程序集的 `[NinoType]`、它们的格式化器和类型 ID。Nino 第一次遇到这个程序集里的类型，或者遇到不认识的类型 ID 时才加载它，所以不需要初始化调用；`NinoRegistry.EnsureInitialized(assembly)` 可以提前加载。**全局注册表**是包含所有 `[NinoType]` 的那张表，声明为 `object` 的值通过它分派；参见[分派](/zh/docs/v4/polymorphism#dispatch)。

en.definition: An object nested more than 128 levels deep, written and read later from a shallower level so that the stack stays bounded; see [Deep Object Graphs](/en/docs/v4/reference-tracking#deep-object-graphs).

zh.definition: 嵌套超过 128 层的对象。Nino 推迟到较浅的层级再写入和读取它，让栈的用量有上限；参见[深层对象图](/zh/docs/v4/reference-tracking#deep-object-graphs)。
